title: Perfect 10 Magazine Spring 1998 All Natural First Year Issue Waiter Poll II
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue in nice shape for its age. Glossy cover is bright with light corner and edge wear, a few small scuffs along the spine edge, and a light surface mark on the embossed back cover. Spine intact. No mailing label. Interior not page-checked - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Perfect 10 Magazine, Spring 1998 issue. Cover price $6.95.

A first-year issue of Norm Zada's Perfect 10 - "The Connoisseur's Magazine" - the title built on its all-natural premise: no cosmetic surgery, shot in high resolution on heavy glossy stock.

Cover lines:
- 15 of the World's Most Naturally Beautiful Women
- Waiter Poll II
- Attention Top Models! $435,000 Perfect 10 Model Search

Red lingerie cover with the studio light in frame. The back cover is the embossed beach figure with the Perfect 10 logo - no advertising - and the spine reads "Spring 98".

Condition: pre-owned with light handling wear; see the photos and condition note.
